office_does: Jefferson County District Court hears misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor cases; its one judge is elected county-wide to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Mindy Walker, on the bench since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Jefferson County's District Court judge since 2019 and its presiding judge; the only candidate.
highlights: Champions the Behavioral Health Court and wants therapeutic courts expanded [S1]
Former judge pro tem and private practitioner in federal, tribal and state courts [S1]
